online co op for twilight princess. 2 to 16 players in one world.

put crests_of_courage.dusk in dusklight's mods folder. a co op tab shows up in the menu bar.
one player presses host and reads out the room, everyone else types it and presses join.

only windows has been played. mac, linux, android and ios are built here but untested.
enemy sync, boss sync and story progress are off by default under unfinished.

this version needs dusklight 2.0.2. it works with 1.7.0 and 1.7.1 players, but most fixes below
only kick in when everyone is on 1.7.2.

this build:

new
- spinner battles: bump into each other on spinners. with pvp on, three hits and you're knocked off.
  blades out means you take no hits
- network tab in the co op window, shows what the connection is doing
- cages sync: break the bars on a monkey's cage (or talo's) and they break for everyone

fixes
- doors no longer swap places or vanish. going through a door could turn a different door around
  on the other player's screen
- teleporting to someone (or joining them) in another room no longer drops you through the floor
- bosses and mini-bosses that only worked for one player now play out for everyone: fyrus, puppet
  zelda, phantom zant, dangoro, deku toad, darkhammer, death sword
- king bulblin (horseback, both jousts, bulblin camp, the castle) and skull kid's chases now play
  out properly for everyone, cutscene and all
- ook cutting the bridge in the forest temple now plays for everyone, even if someone else saw it
  first. before, the second player got no cutscene and the bridge never fell
- gates, doors and scenes that open when enemies die now open for everyone, not just whoever got
  the kill. includes shadow beast portals
- things you'd be stuck without if someone else did the scene: midna's button, wolf senses,
  warping from the map, midna's energy field, calling epona, having epona at all. now everyone
  gets them
- the world stays the same shape for everyone: bridges midna warps, zora's domain thawing, the sky
  cannon, the gate after the wagon escort, the death mountain wall, the mirror of twilight
- clearing a dungeon counts for everyone, even if they reach the boss room after it's beaten
- story progress sharing no longer gets stuck on conversations the game resets (iza, trill's shop,
  ooccoo's letters and a few more)
- area triggers no longer fire for the wrong player (camera, hints, faron fog)
- bomblings: they blink and blow up on everyone's screen now, not just yours
- bomblings: picking one up shows a bombling bomb in your hands for everyone, not a normal bomb,
  and the bombling is gone right away instead of hanging around
- bomblings: no more duplicates or double bombs when you pick one up or hookshot it
- boomerang + bomblings: a catch now happens on everyone's screen, not just the thrower's
- sumo: bo no longer calls anyone over or talks on his own. to accept a challenge, face the other
  player in the ring and press A
- pvp: mortal draw knocks people the way you slashed, not in a random direction
- pvp: a knocked-down player's hitbox now lies down with them, and so does the lock-on
- pvp: ending blow timing is tighter
